summary.name: Download Shuttle
summary.one_liner: Download Shuttle is a macOS download manager that splits files into up to 6 parallel segments to speed up downloads.
use_cases: Speed up large file downloads on a Mac
Queue multiple URLs for download at once
Download password-protected files with HTTP authentication
Resume interrupted downloads after network drops or quitting the app
Send links from Chrome or Safari to a download manager
summary.what_it_does: Download Shuttle splits each file into up to 6 segments that download in parallel to use available bandwidth. Users paste a URL, choose a destination and segment count, and can schedule downloads or add HTTP authentication. An Inspector view shows per-segment progress, speed and status in real time. Downloads can be paused and resumed, including after quitting the app, and resume automatically when the network reconnects. Extra features include browser extensions for Chrome and Safari, batch adding of URLs, QuickLook preview of completed files, a downloadshuttle:// URL scheme, and a option to keep the Mac awake during transfers.
notable: Splits each file into up to 6 parallel segments with a real-time Inspector view
Credentials stored in Keychain; supports downloadshuttle:// URL scheme for automation
Listed in jaywcjlove/awesome-mac under Download Management Tools
caveats: Only available for macOS as described on the page
